description: Is the API fast and healthy? RED across every /api/v1 route, then saturation, then a per-route breakdown.

panels.title: RED: every /api/v1 route (ignores the route picker)
Requests/s
panels.description: Rate. Requests per second across every /api/v1 route, over the last minute.

panels.title: 5xx error ratio
panels.description: Errors. Share of requests answered 5xx over the last 5 minutes. Red from 0.1%.

panels.title: Latency p95 (S1)
panels.description: Duration. 95th percentile over the last 5 minutes. S1: under 200 ms.

panels.title: Share under 200 ms
panels.description: Requests answered within 200 ms over the last 5 minutes. Exact, not interpolated: 0.2 is a bucket edge.

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Requests received and not yet answered. Reads at least 1, because the scrape itself is in flight. Negative means the hook order broke.

panels.title: API up
panels.description: Whether Prometheus could scrape the API on its last attempt.

panels.title: Rate: requests/s by status code
panels.description: Every /api/v1 route, stacked by status code: 2xx green, 4xx orange, 5xx red. 4xx are client errors (auth, validation, not found); they do not count against the 5xx ratio.

panels.title: Errors: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of requests answered 5xx. Red line at 0.1%. Gaps mean no traffic.

panels.title: Duration: latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Every /api/v1 route. S1 is the p95 under 200 ms (red line).

panels.title: Max requests/s
panels.description: The most requests answered in one second, any status, measured between consecutive scrapes (10 s apart). The highest value observed in the selected time range, so it stays after the traffic stops.

panels.title: Max requests/min
panels.description: The most requests answered in any 60 seconds of the selected range. The highest value observed in the selected time range, so it stays after the traffic stops.

panels.title: Max req/s within SLO
panels.description: The highest request rate (over a minute) at which p95 stayed under 200 ms (S1) and 5xx under 0.1%: the most the API serves before it breaks. Below max requests/s means load past this point broke an SLO. A dash means no minute of the range met both, or there was no traffic. The highest value observed in the selected time range, so it stays after the traffic stops.

targets.expr: max_over_time((sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"/api/v1/.*"}[1m])) and on () (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="api", route=~"/api/v1/.*"}[1m]))) < 0.2) and on () ((sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"/api/v1/.*", status_code=~"5.."}[1m])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"/api/v1/.*"}[1m])) < 0.001))[$__range:10s])

panels.title: Max p95 (1 min)
panels.description: The highest p95 latency over any minute of the range. Red from 200 ms (S1). The highest value observed in the selected time range, so it stays after the traffic stops.

panels.title: Max 5xx ratio (1 min)
panels.description: The highest share of 5xx responses over any minute of the range. Red from 0.1%. The highest value observed in the selected time range, so it stays after the traffic stops.

panels.title: Avg req/s while busy
panels.description: Requests per second averaged over the moments of the range with any traffic: the sustained rate. The highest value observed in the selected time range, so it stays after the traffic stops.

panels.title: Requests/s by status code (10 s resolution)
panels.description: Requests answered per second between consecutive scrapes, stacked by status code: 2xx green, 4xx orange, 5xx red. Under load, the first sign of breaking is 5xx (statement timeouts) or a flat top while latency climbs.

panels.title: Latency vs throughput
panels.description: Each point is one moment of the range: requests/s over the minute before it (x) against p95 latency over the same minute (y). As traffic rises the points run flat, then bend upward: the bend is the throughput where the API stops keeping up. Points above 0.2 s are outside S1.

panels.title: Counts per window (follows the route picker)
Requests per endpoint per window
panels.description: Requests each endpoint (method and route) answered in each window, any status, exact. A bar labelled 09:00 counts 09:00 to 09:10. The last group is the window in progress: it grows every scrape until the window closes. The Bucket picker sets the window; a long time range widens it to keep the bars readable.

targets.expr: (sum by (method, route) (last_over_time(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval)) - sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route"})) >= 0 or sum by (method, route) (last_over_time(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval))

panels.title: Requests in range by endpoint
panels.description: Exact request counts over the selected time range, by status class. Total = 2xx + 3xx + 4xx + 5xx. An API restart inside the range counts from the restart.

targets.expr: (sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route"}) - sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route"} offset $__range)) >= 0 or sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route"}) or sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route"} * 0)

(sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route", status_code=~"2.."}) - sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route", status_code=~"2.."} offset $__range)) >= 0 or sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route", status_code=~"2.."}) or sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route"} * 0)

(sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route", status_code=~"3.."}) - sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route", status_code=~"3.."} offset $__range)) >= 0 or sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route", status_code=~"3.."}) or sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route"} * 0)

(sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route", status_code=~"4.."}) - sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route", status_code=~"4.."} offset $__range)) >= 0 or sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route", status_code=~"4.."}) or sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route"} * 0)

(sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route", status_code=~"5.."}) - sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route", status_code=~"5.."} offset $__range)) >= 0 or sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route", status_code=~"5.."}) or sum by (method, route) (http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route"} * 0)

panels.title: Latency p95 by status code
panels.description: Fast 4xx: rejected before the database (auth, validation). 5xx near 5 s: the statement_timeout.

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Requests received and not yet answered. Climbing with latency means requests are queueing.

panels.title: Event loop lag p99
panels.description: Latency up with loop lag up: CPU-bound. Latency up with loop lag flat: waiting on Postgres.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Process CPU time per second. 100% is one full core.

panels.title: Resident memory
panels.description: Process resident set size. Climbing without levelling off under steady load points to a leak.

panels.title: p95 latency by route (S1)
panels.description: 95th percentile per route pattern. S1: under 200 ms (red line).

panels.title: Requests/s by route and status
panels.description: Every status code each route returns.

panels.title: Routes: which are running high
panels.description: Each number covers the whole selected time range, worst p95 first. An empty 5xx cell means that route returned none. Routes faster than the smallest bucket (5 ms) all read about 5 ms.

targets.expr: sum by (route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route", status_code=~"4.."}[$__range])) / sum by (route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route"}[$__range]))

sum by (route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route", status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) / sum by (route) (rate(http_request_duration_seconds_count{job="api", route=~"$route"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Slow requests
panels.description: Traces over 200 ms for the picked routes: the trace behind a point above the S1 line. Needs OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=false (make up-all).

title: Api
